name: ATS-friendly Resume Template
description: A free, editable resume starter with a simple single-column layout and standard section headings. Includes a Word document (.docx), a matching plain-text copy and short customization instructions in one ZIP download. Replace the bracketed placeholders with your own details, skills and accomplishments. No tables, text boxes, photos or decorative graphics are embedded in the resume. Follow the employer's requested file format and review any fields filled automatically after uploading.
